termsPolicies.description:
• Pass must be activated (unlocked) before it can be used. Activation must be performed within the date and time specified on the activation email or the Pass will expire. Expired Pass cannot be reissued or reinstated.
  • Upon successful activation, vouchers will be added to the Smart Traveller mobile app wallet. Arrture points, if any, will be issued to the account of the Smart Traveller member who activated the Pass.
  • The Buggy service is exclusively provided at the Hong Kong International Airport, whereas access to designated lounges is available.
  • This pass grants the voucher holder up to 3-hour lounge access to the respective Service Locations. Services/facilities may vary at each Service Location.
  • This Pass is valid for 12 months from the date of activation.
  • The Buggy & Lounge Pass and its benefits may be subject to change or discontinuation at any time without prior notice.
  • Pass purchase is final, non-cancellable, non-refundable and non-replaceable.

• The Canada Pass (“PPL Pass”) grants visits to designated lounges in Canada & Americas only.
  • PPL Pass must be activated (unlocked) before it can be used. Activation must be performed within the date and time specified on the activation email or the PPL Pass will expire. Expired PPL Pass cannot be reissued or reinstated.
  • Smart Traveller members: Upon successful activation PPL Pass lounge access voucher(s) (“Voucher”) will be added to the Smart Traveller mobile app wallet. Arrture points, if any, will be issued to the account of the Smart Traveller member who activated the PPL Pass.
  • Non-Smart Traveller members: Upon successful activation, Voucher will be emailed to the registered email address provided at the time of activation.
  • Unless otherwise specified, Voucher is valid for twelve (12) months upon PPL Pass activation.
  • PPL Pass purchase, Voucher and any applicable Arrture points issuance are final, non-cancellable, non-refundable and non-replaceable. Plaza Premium Lounge shall not be responsible for any loss, theft, damage, or unauthorised use of the Voucher.
  • The Vouchers are transferable provided always that the transfer is not a part of any sale or exchange for value.
  • The Vouchers have no cash value and cannot be exchanged for cash, points, or any other services or products.
  • Unless otherwise specified, each Voucher grants the voucher holder up to 3-hour lounge access only per visit to eligible lounges (“Service Locations”). Operating hours, services, and facilities may vary at each Service Location. This Voucher does not entitle the Voucher holder to any other services/products other than lounge access, and the Voucher holder agrees to pay for the use of any chargeable services/products offered at the relevant Service Location.
  • Access to Service Locations using Vouchers is not eligible for any rewards or loyalty points accrual.
  • The Voucher cannot be used in conjunction with any promotion or offer.
  • Read the full Terms and Conditions.
